Kokilaben ko naam chahiye... aur GROUP BY sirf total batata hai! Isiliye aaya Window Function. Data analyst interviews ka favourite sawaal!
Ye rahi IPL match ki table. Rohit aur Surya, Mumbai mein. Dhoni aur Jadeja, Chennai mein.
Team-wise total runs chahiye? GROUP BY lagao. Mumbai, sau runs. Chennai, assi runs. Easy!
Lekin interviewer bola: mujhe har player ka naam bhi chahiye, aur saath mein uski team ka total bhi! Ab GROUP BY fail! Kyunki usne rows ko collapse kar diya.
Yahan entry hoti hai Window Function ki! SUM runs OVER, PARTITION BY team.
Har player ki row safe, aur saath mein team total! Rohit aur Surya, sau. Dhoni aur Jadeja, assi.
